title: GOD PROVIDES AND BLESSES HIS PEOPLE

blocks.text: “Ever so often the Holy Spirit moves upon me to bring Scriptures to remind the Lord’s people that He hears their prayers and will protect, supply and provide their needs!” – “Often people wonder in an inflationary economy like this or even in severe hard times, will God provide and bless His people? Yes, He absolutely will! He will supply your needs no matter what kind of times; depression, inflation, famine, etc. Remember Abraham and Joseph, etc. It doesn’t matter about the times, what counts is faith, then acting on what it might be that you have!” – “We can refer to the case of Elijah the prophet! (I Kings 17:13-14) wherein the woman was a type of our day’s elect! The supply shall not fail!” – “Also Elijah was translated and the elect also will be!” – “By acting, God will always supply your need! Because giving is an act of faith! Jesus will not fail! Sometimes delay, but definitely not fail!” – “He will prosper and provide! Even during times of prosperity people must act on what they have or they will not be blessed in accordance to God’s way!”

In St. Luke 12:16-21, “Jesus reveals, although the rich man had much he left God out of his planning completely; therefore he ended up with nothing but the loss of even his soul!” – Verses 6-7, “reveal that the Lord Jesus sees your every tear and hears your prayers always! So trust Him forever!”

Luke 12:23-34, in these verses we will confirm what we have been speaking about in the beginning of this letter. So read it carefully and Jesus will certainly bless and prosper you! – Verse 22 says, “take no thought what ye shall eat or what ye shall wear! Verse 23, the life is more than meat, and the body is more than raiment!” – Verse 24, “Consider the ravens: for they neither sow nor reap; which neither have storehouse nor barn; and God feedeth them: how much more are ye better than the fowls? – It’s significant that he mentions the ravens for they are the ones who fed Elijah supernaturally!” (I Kings 17:6) “And according to this God works best when the storehouse is near empty or empty!” Luke 12:25, “reveals not to worry for that won’t do it, that won’t change things, but to rejoice in His promises for God’s ravens (type of angels) will visit you too!” – Verse 27, “says to be like nature, just open up and completely trust the Lord and that you don’t have to be a Solomon to be prospered! Yes, even you can receive all you need!” – “Verse 28 mentions even the grass in the field is here one day and gone the next and God provides! How much more will He clothe you! And for those who cannot believe or act upon these Scriptures He boldly declares, O ye of little faith! In the next verse He also reminds you not to worry and be not of doubtful mind. He is standing right with you! Remember sometimes delay, but never fails! By this Jesus is teaching us to trust! And in verse 31, He reveals to seek spiritual things and all these other blessings shall be supplied!”

Verse 34, “He says, wherever your treasure is, there your heart will be also! So let us all give, and work to save souls and therefore our profits (rewards) will be in heaven to meet us! – Glory! – “Behold saith the Lord Jesus for this is my command to you in this hour! Hag. 2:4, Be strong, all ye people of the land, saith the Lord, and work: for I am with you, saith the Lord of Hosts!”

“I might mention that I preached a message here and God gave me these Scriptures, Hag. 2:4-9. And a prophetic anointing came upon the message and a feeling of the future became real! As I feel there will be economic problems and that there will be a shaking in many things! Earthquakes, inventions that shake the heavens, quakes in the sea, the land will be affected! And verses 4-9 became like dates to me being the years ahead to be the most profound changes that the people have ever seen! In those years I feel worldwide rebellion, wars, new and different leaders. And there shall also be a great outpouring of the glory of God in His latter house!” – “It is hard to describe here all that was in the message, these are just a few facts! – And should the church be taken the events we spoke about will still take place for the rest of the world!” – “Let us watch, for we are entering a new era of absolute change for the way the United States will be run! And the greatest events and revolutionary changes for the world will occur.” – “But remember no matter about the perilous times and changes coming, the Lord will stand with you!”

“Before we close, here is a secret!” – “The Bible says: God loves a cheerful giver and that he who sows bountifully will reap bountifully!” – “The Scriptures reveal that Jesus wants you to prosper and be in health even as your soul prospereth!” – “Jesus also said, everyone that giveth, receiveth, and everyone that seeketh, findeth! So armed with all these promises let it be according to your faith and start off with confidence! He is with you!”

Here is a reprint for your benefit, always keep them in mind when you need encouragement. – “The Lord created the earth’s wealth for the prosperity of those who do His will in soul winning and deliverance of others!” In Ex. 19:5, “All the earth is mine.” “The land is mine.” (Lev. 25:23) “Every beast of the forest is mine and the cattle on a thousand hills!” (Ps. 50:10) “The silver is mine, and the gold is mine! (Hag. 2:8) “For the earth is the Lord’s, and the fullness thereof!” (I Cor. 10:26) – “And He will give all this to whomsoever He will! To those who act and give in regularity!” “Jesus said, Be it according to your faith! You can have all that you expect and believe for!” – “Thou shalt remember the Lord thy God for it is He that giveth the power to get wealth!” (Deut. 8:18) – “Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord, that delighteth greatly in His commandments. WEALTH AND RICHES shall be in His house!” (Ps. 112:1-3) – “The Bible says, honor the Lord with thy substance and first fruits, and so shall thy barns be filled with plenty!” (Prov. 3:9-10) “Have confidence in these promises and do your part and He shall not fail thee as you pray for God to supply all your needs! As Jesus leads He will prosper and bless you wonderfully!”
In God’s abundant love and blessings,
